description: This file defines the UpdateFilterModel class, which serves as a model object used in the update filter process within the OpenMRS web application. It manages properties related to database updates, such as change sets, version info, and update requirements, and provides methods for retrieving unexecuted database changes.

classes.name: UpdateFilterModel
classes.description: A model class managing properties and logic for the update filter process, including database change set management, update requirements, and version info.

methods.name: UpdateFilterModel
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the model with default provider implementations.

methods.name: UpdateFilterModel
methods.description: Constructor allowing injection of specific LiquibaseProvider and DatabaseUpdaterWrapper instances, and initializing update change tracking.

methods.name: updateChanges
methods.description: Method to refresh the list of unrun database changes from the liquibase provider.
